result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major missing image in the 'Popular right now' section, and one minor text truncation issue in the restaurant listing.

issues.description: The first restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) is displaying a broken/missing image placeholder instead of the actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset is correctly uploaded and the image URL is valid. Add a proper fallback image for cases where the restaurant photo fails to load.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is being truncated and cut off at the edge of the screen without a visible ellipsis or proper truncation handling.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a max-width constraint on restaurant name labels in the horizontal scroll cards to ensure names are gracefully truncated rather than hard-clipped.
